neighbours.label: The position right before 'here' is predictable: a noun or verb that sets up 'X here' (two options [here], what is happening [here]), a next-token predictor for 'here', vs the same nouns where 'here' is not expected
fire: Let me be honest, I have no idea what is going on with this printer.
Okay, so we basically have two choices before the deadline.
Honestly, I can't figure out what is happening with my laptop.
Alright, there are three possibilities that I can see.
Look, the real problem is not the money at all.
So the main takeaway, if you remember one thing, is to rest.
Well, there is one big question that nobody has answered.
Can someone explain what is going on with the website today?
quiet: Let me be honest, I have no idea how old this printer is.
Okay, so we basically ate two sandwiches before the deadline.
Honestly, I can't remember where I bought my laptop.
Alright, there are three cats sleeping on the sofa.
Look, the red car is parked behind the bakery.
So the main road, if you follow it, leads to the station.
Well, there is one big tree in the middle of the yard.
Can someone carry the boxes up to the office today?

predictions: Fire items 0.3-0.6 on the word before the expected 'here'; near misses under 0.1. Near misses that keep the setup will fire, so they change the setup.
notes: Card: ' options', ' issue', ' happening', ' play', ' note', ' keyword', ' at work', all before 'here' or a similar locative; the + pole promotes ' here' in many languages. Probe: 'two options here' 0.468 and 'two options for dinner' 0.468 (same prefix, so the score comes before 'here'), 'what is happening' 0.377; 'The problematic issue here' 0.024 (sentence-initial noun), 'things in the box' 0.004.
